title: Explainability & Interpretability (XAI)
description: Demystify black-box models. Master SHAP values, LIME local surrogates, attention heatmaps, and regulatory requirements.

slides.title: Opening the Black Box 📦
slides.content:
# The Need for Explainability (XAI)

In high-stakes domains (healthcare triage, loan underwriting, criminal justice), deploying a high-performing "black-box" model is unacceptable. Regulators, clinicians, and consumers demand to know **why** a decision was made.

### Interpretability vs Explainability:
* **Interpretable Models (Glass-Box):** Inherently transparent architectures (e.g. shallow Decision Trees, Linear Regression, rule lists).
* **Explainable Models (Post-Hoc XAI):** Methods applied after training to probe and explain complex black boxes (e.g. deep neural networks, gradient boosted trees).

slides.title: Core Explainability Frameworks 🔍
slides.content:
# Comparing Post-Hoc XAI Methods

| Method | Core Concept | Output | Best Application |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations)**| Game-theoretic Shapley values distributing contribution across features | Additive feature credit (+/- contribution to baseline) | Tabular data, tree ensembles, financial auditing |
| **LIME** | Fits an interpretable linear surrogate model locally around the prediction | Local feature weight attribution | Quick inspection of individual tabular/text predictions |
| **Grad-CAM** | Computes gradient flow into final convolutional layers | Saliency heatmaps highlighting pixel regions | Explaining computer vision CNN classifications |
| **Attention Visualization** | Inspects cross-token attention matrices | Heatmap matrix connecting input words | Explaining Transformer text translations |

quizData.question: What mathematical guarantee uniquely distinguishes SHAP values based on cooperative game theory?

options.text: They guarantee the underlying model achieves 100% test accuracy
They satisfy efficiency, symmetry, dummy player, and additivity axioms from game theory
They make all neural network layers linear
They eliminate all computational overhead during inference

quizData.explanation: Lloyd Shapley's cooperative game theory axioms guarantee that total prediction deviation from baseline is fair and additively partitioned across all participating features.

slides.title: Interpreting Predictions with SHAP Logic 🐍
slides.codeSnippet:
base_rate = 0.50 # average approval probability
feature_contributions = {
    'High Credit Score': +0.32,
    'Stable Employment': +0.12,
    'High Debt-to-Income': -0.18
}

prediction = base_rate + sum(feature_contributions.values())
print(f'Base Rate:           {base_rate:.2f}')
for feat, val in feature_contributions.items():
    print(f'  {feat:20s}: {val:+.2f}')
print(f'Final Predicted Prob: {prediction:.2f}')

slides.title: AI Pro Tip: The EU AI Act 📜
slides.content:
## Regulatory Mandates for XAI
The European Union's AI Act mandates that high-risk AI systems (medical diagnosis, biometric categorization, credit scoring) must provide explainable outputs and maintain full audit logging for human oversight!
